Name: Lychen The Visitor - A Strange Capsule Revamp
Author: KrittsKore
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50015/50015-1785554821-975674370.png[/img]

[center][size=5][font=Georgia][i]They've arrived! Or, wait... they've always been here?[/i][/font][/size][/center]

[center][font=Courier New]Lychen appeared seemingly out of nowhere a few months after you settled into the valley. No one talks about them as if they're new... instead, everyone treats them like they've always been part of the community. They've grown especially close to Evelyn, and the town's mothers have taken a liking to them. The younger residents, however, seem a little more wary...[/font]
[/center]
[center][font=Courier New][b]The story relies on having seen as few spoilers as possible! I recommend going in blind.[/b][/font][/center]

[center][u][font=Courier New][b][color=#cc0000][size=6]THIS MOD IS UNFINISHED AND A WORK IN PROGRESS![/size][/color][/b][/font][/u][/center]
[center][u][font=Courier New][b][color=#cc0000][size=4]EXPECT BUGS AND HEAVY CHANGES TO THE EVENTS[/size][/color][/b][/font][/u][/center]
[center][/center]
[font=Courier New][b][size=4]🌱 Installation and Setup 🌱[/size][/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]Play with this mod in a new save file if you've already gone past Fall 1st of Year 1 (Ly simply will not spawn). [/font][/*]
[*][font=Courier New]At the same time, if you're using mods like [b]CJB Cheats Menu[/b] or [b]No Friendship Decay[/b], I ask that you [b][i][size=4]keep Friendship Decay[/size] [size=4][u]on[/u][/size][/i][/b] as it's tied to an important part of the mod in one of its routes.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Courier New]I highly recommend that you use a mod like [b]NightEventChanceTweak [/b]to get rid of the original Strange Capsule event, as it has been replaced by a copy that happens on a specific date. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Keep in mind this mod focuses on your relationships and dialogue with other townies, so it's going to mess with that a fair bit (once it's finished; for now, it's just the basics).[/font][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50015/50015-1785551724-1717710763.png[/img]
[font=Courier New][size=4][b]About Lychen[/b][/size][/font]
[font=Courier New][size=3]Ly uses any pronouns. However, said pronouns commonly reflect the person they're talking to: if that's a she, Ly is she/her, if that's a he, Ly is he/him, if that's a they, Ly is they/them. It's like a mirror.[/size][/font]
[font=Courier New][size=3][i]//Basically, use your own pronouns for them.[/i][/size][/font]

[font=Courier New]You can usually find Lychen in the mornings watering Evelyn's plants (even in the rain; that's not a bug). [/font]

[font=Courier New][b]Gift Tastes[/b][/font]
[spoiler][font=Courier New]Loves: Pancakes, Moss Soup, Moss, Tea Set, Sweet Pea, Crystal Fruit, Sunflower, Golden Egg, Mystic Syrup, Stardrop Tea.
Likes:  Fish Taco, Crispy Bass, Cookies, Cranberry Candy, Daffodil, Dandelion, Cranberries, Wine, Juice, Strawberry, Common Mushroom, Rabbit's Foot, all seeds.[/font][/spoiler]


[center][font=Courier New][size=4][b]🍀 Events + Routes 🍀 [/b][/size][/font][/center]
[center][font=Courier New][color=#d4d4d8]Lychen has two routes: [/color][b][color=#f6b26b]Friend Route[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] and [/color][b][color=#ff0000]Obsession Route[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]. Currently, the Obsession Route is further in progress, though it's lacking the marriage events, and the one I [b]highly [/b]recommend you play with. Following community feedback, I plan to release the full version of the mod with both routes fully finished.[/color][/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Courier New][b]Event Guide:[/b][/font][/center]
[spoiler][center][b][color=#d4d4d8][font=Courier New]Note: Most of these are linear, meaning they require you to have seen the previous one before triggering.[/font][/color][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[font=Courier New][b][color=#d4d4d8]1 heart:[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] Any season but winter, sunny day, enter town between 6:00 and 11:00.[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]2 hearts (pt 1):[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] Sunny Tuesday, enter Pierre's between 16:00 and [/color][color=#d4d4d8]20:00.[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]2 hearts (pt 2): [/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]Requires you've already met the wizard face to face[/color][color=#d4d4d8]. You'll get a letter on the mail after pt 1, follow its instructions[/color][color=#d4d4d8].[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]4 hearts:[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] Sunny day, enter the beach between 17:00 and 21:30.[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]6 hearts (pt 1): [/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]Friday, enter the saloon between 20:00 and 23:00.[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]6 hearts (pt 2) [/color][color=#ff0000](ROUTE SPLIT! CHOOSE THE MEAN OPTION!)[/color][color=#d4d4d8]: [/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]Sleep 4 times (3 days) after pt 1. After you get a message overnight, go outside of your farmhouse between 6:00 and 23:00. If you choose the Friend Route option, you'll get a special ending for this event, but you'll have to [i]reset the day[/i] to return to the Obsession Route.[/color]

[b]Obsession Route
[/b][b][color=#d4d4d8]8 hearts: [/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]Sleep once and read the letter in the mail. Enter the wizard's tower with an Earth Crystal.[/color]
[b]10 hearts:[/b] After you've read Ly's letter, enter the town between 22:00 and 2am.[/font][/spoiler]

[font=Courier New][size=4][b]🍄 Planned Features 🍄 [/b][/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]A new map in the Secret Forest to find where the Strange Capsule landed.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Obsession Route 12 and 14 heart events.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Friend Route 8, 10, 12 and 14 heart events.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Seasonal outfits and portraits.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Courier New]More dialogue from the other townies.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Compatibility with other mods/custom npcs.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Family events with Ly and their kids.[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Courier New][size=4][b]☘️ Requirements ☘️ [/b][/size][/font]
[list]
[*][b][font=Courier New][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Spacecore[/color][/size][/font][/b][/*]
[*][font=Courier New][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Content Patcher[/b][/color][/size][/font][/*]
[/list]
[center][font=Courier New][color=#f6b26b][size=4]Feedback is highly appreciated! This is my first [i]ever [/i]mod, so it's prone to have bugs, syntax errors, or other stuff. Don't take reference from my code if you're a new modder.[/size][/color][/font][/center]

[center][b]I do not give permission for AI generated works to be integrated/made compatible with Lychen. Nor do I consent for anyone to insert any of my code, dialogue, events, or images into an AI model.[/b] [/center]
